ownership: Original fictional teaching schematic and its derivatives prepared with AI assistance for Odejobi Abiola Samuel / CTROTECH. Publication copyright and third-party software rights retained; no new open editorial license.
raster_generation: CairoSVG renders at widths 400, 800 and 1200 with matching 16:9 heights; Pillow quantizes RGBA with FASTOCTREE to 128 colors and optimizes PNG output. Supplied derivatives are maintained assets, not regenerated during normal builds.
media_generation: FFmpeg renders the 640x360 schematic as four-second static video at two frames/second. A synthesized 440Hz tone has source duration 0.5 seconds, volume multiplier 0.15, then padded silence. MP4 uses H.264/AAC; WebM uses VP9/Opus. Caption [Short tone] runs 0–0.6 seconds, allowing the initial tone and encoding timing.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

audio_signal_probe.scope: Signal presence and container evidence, not human listening or caption-usability review.

visual_review: Same-agent inspection of an actually decoded first frame; source labels and spatial relationships remained visible. Not real-premises directions, independent image review or assistive-technology approval.
